title: Mortgage origination bundle
description: Borrower, property, loan, and underwriting evidence for mortgage origination.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: fs-mortgage-origination
  title: Mortgage origination bundle
  description: Borrower, property, loan, and underwriting evidence for mortgage origination.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-fin-02
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/financial-services
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [customer_party.borrower_last_name, loan_facility.loan_amount, mortgage_property.property_state, mortgage_property.ltv_percent, applicant_financial_profile.debt_to_income_ratio]
      relationshipIds: [borrows_from, secured_by_property, underwritten_with]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/fs/mortgage_application, role: start }
